sql.overridesManagement.setApprovalStatus: UPDATE brs.override_closer SET effective_date = :effectiveDate::DATE, override_closer_status_type_id = :statusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUserId, date_approved = (CASE WHEN :statusTypeId = 2 THEN now() END), approved_by_id = (CASE WHEN :statusTypeId = 2 THEN :currentUserId END) WHERE id = :overrideCloserId
sql.overridesManagement.getOfficeAllowances: select distinct upv.office AS "officeName", upv.office_id, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(office_override_allowances))) FROM (select id, allowance, start_date as "startDate", end_date as "endDate", archived from brs.office_override_allowance ooa1 where ooa1.office_id = ooa.office_id and ooa1.archived IS NOT TRUE order by ooa1.start_date desc) as office_override_allowances)::text as allowances from brs.user_positions_vw upv left join brs.office_override_allowance ooa on ooa.office_id = upv.office_id where upv.office_id is not null and office_org_type_id = 3 and office_active is true order by upv.office
sql.overridesManagement.addNewAllowancesForO: INSERT INTO brs.office_override_allowance (office_id, allowance, start_date, end_date, archived) VALUES (:officeId, :allowance, :startDate, :endDate, FALSE)
sql.overridesManagement.updateAllowancesForO: UPDATE brs.office_override_allowance SET office_id = :officeId, allowance = :allowance, start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate, archived = :archived WHERE id = :id
sql.overridesManagement.getAssignableUsers: select first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, pv.user_id as id from brs.user_positions_vw pv where position_id in (1,2,3) and primary_flag is true and end_date is null and active is true and user_status_type_id = 1 order by first_name,last_name
sql.overridesManagement.createAssignment: INSERT INTO brs.override_closer (closer_user_id, effective_date, date_created, created_by_id, override_closer_status_type_id) VALUES (:closerId, :effectiveDate, now(), :createdById, 1) RETURNING id
sql.overridesManagement.updateCloserOverride:
UPDATE brs.overrides_on_closer SET override_amount = :amount, created_date = now() WHERE id = :rowId;
update brs.override_closer set override_closer_status_type_id = 1, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :overrideCloserId
sql.overridesManagement.insertCloserOverride: INSERT INTO brs.overrides_on_closer (override_closer_id, user_id, override_amount, created_date) VALUES (:overrideCloserId, :userId, :amount, now())
sql.overridesManagement.getOverridesReceived: with regional_manager AS ( select region_id from brs.user_positions_vw where user_id = :userId and primary_flag IS TRUE and active IS TRUE and position_id = 3 and region_id IS NOT NULL ) select foo2.user_id,closer_name,override_amount, case when tiu.id is not null then 'Yes' else 'No' end as counts_for_par_bonus from ( with max_effective_date as ( select max(effective_date) as effective_date,closer_user_id from ( select * from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id where user_id = :userId and effective_date <= :effectiveDate::date and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2) as foo group by closer_user_id) select user_id,closer_name,(coalesce(allowance,0) - override_amount-recruited_amount) as override_amount from ( select sum(override_amount) as override_amount,allowance,foo.recruited_amount,user_id,closer_name from ( with max_region_effective_date as ( select max(effective_date) as effective_date,closer_user_id from ( select * from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id inner join brs.user_positions_vw upv on upv.user_id = oc.closer_user_id and upv.primary_flag is true and upv.user_status_type_id =1 where upv.region_id = (select region_id from regional_manager) and effective_date <= :effectiveDate::date and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2) as foo group by closer_user_id) select case when recruited_by_user_id is not null then 20.00 else 0.00 end as recruited_amount, ooc.override_amount,pv.first_name || ' ' || pv.last_name as closer_name, (select allowance from brs.office_override_allowance ro where oc.date_created::date >= start_date and case when end_date is not null then oc.date_created::date <= end_date else 1=1 end and ro.office_id = pv.office_id) as allowance, pv.user_id from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id inner join max_region_effective_date med on med.effective_date = oc.effective_date and med.closer_user_id = oc.closer_user_id inner join brs.user_positions_vw pv on pv.user_id = oc.closer_user_id where pv.region_id = (select region_id from regional_manager) and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2 and primary_flag is true and end_date is null and active is true ) as foo group by allowance,foo.recruited_amount,user_id,closer_name) as foo1 union all select user_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name as closer_name,override_amount from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id inner join max_effective_date med on med.effective_date = oc.effective_date and med.closer_user_id = oc.closer_user_id inner join brs.user u on u.id = oc.closer_user_id and ooc.user_id = :userId and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2) as foo2 left join brs.trip_incentive_user tiu on tiu.user_id = foo2.user_id order by closer_name

select foo2.user_id,closer_name,override_amount, case when tiu.id is not null then 'Yes' else 'No' end as counts_for_par_bonus from ( with max_effective_date as ( select max(effective_date) as effective_date,closer_user_id from ( select * from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id where user_id = :userId and effective_date <= :effectiveDate::date and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2) as foo group by closer_user_id) select user_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name as closer_name,override_amount from brs.override_closer oc inner join brs.overrides_on_closer ooc on ooc.override_closer_id = oc.id inner join max_effective_date med on med.effective_date = oc.effective_date and med.closer_user_id = oc.closer_user_id inner join brs.user u on u.id = oc.closer_user_id and ooc.user_id = :userId and oc.override_closer_status_type_id = 2) as foo2 left join brs.trip_incentive_user tiu on tiu.user_id = foo2.user_id order by closer_name
